sources.name: Sokuja

restrictions: Self-declared index of third-party uploads with no claim of distribution rights.
sources.next_action: None unless the operator demonstrates distribution rights or rights-holder authorization.

sources.name: AnimeIndo
sources.content: Anime and film streaming site (Indonesian subtitles)
sources.permission: Prohibited by the site's own terms of service.
evidence: Title: 'Nonton Anime Sub Indo Gratis - Streaming Anime Terbaru HD | AnimeIndo'.

/page/terms-of-service: 'Permission is granted to temporarily download one copy of the materials on Animeindo's Website for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only ... under this license you may not: modify or copy the materials; use the materials for any commercial purpose or for any public display; attempt to reverse engineer any software contained on Animeindo's Website'.

Artwork is served from image.tmdb.org; listed titles include currently airing commercial series.

restrictions: Terms forbid copying and redistributing site materials and reverse engineering its software; a third-party client re-presenting its catalog conflicts with them.
sources.next_action: None unless the operator grants written permission and shows distribution rights.

sources.name: Jellyfin (user's own server)
sources.content: The user's own media library on a self-hosted Jellyfin server

integration.method: Documented REST API with token authentication

sources.permission: Users access their own server with their own account; the API is the official client interface.
evidence: All endpoints used were exercised on a local Jellyfin 12.2.0 server (official Linux build) with a public-domain film and a synthetic test series.
Accept: application/json yields PascalCase JSON; a wildcard Accept yields camelCase (verified).
LiveServerTest (login, catalog, details, episodes, ranged stream with header auth, subtitle download) passed against that server.
The aniyomi-extensions-inspector v1.5.0.2 instantiated the release APK: id 1100359934660540567, baseUrl ''.
sources.technical: Login via POST /Users/AuthenticateByName, catalog via /Items, episodes via /Shows/{id}/Episodes, direct play via /Videos/{id}/stream?static=true, text subtitles via /Videos/{id}/{source}/Subtitles/{index}/0/Stream.srt.
restrictions: No transcoding requested; the player must support the original codec.
Seasons are flattened into one episode list.
sources.next_action: Install the APK in Anikku and test against a real library; consider lib-16 seasons and a multi-server factory.

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.content: Animation & Cartoons collections: public-domain and openly licensed films plus community uploads

integration.method: Public Advanced Search and Metadata APIs

sources.permission: Public API; access-restricted (lending) items and private files are excluded. Each item declares its own rights.
evidence: Fixture tests on recorded responses and an opt-in live test (search, metadata, HEAD on a resolved video URL) passed.
Inspector reported id 1829328537302010998, baseUrl https://archive.org.
Deep paging is limited to 10,000 results ([DEEP_PAGING] error verified).
sources.technical: advancedsearch.php for catalog/search, /metadata/{id} for details, episodes and video files, /download/ for media.
restrictions: Rights are as declared by uploaders; 'latest' includes community uploads.
No language filter (language metadata too sparse).
sources.next_action: On-device test; consider more curated collections.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.content: Freely licensed and public-domain media, including animated films
sources.permission: Content is freely licensed per file; the API is public, subject to Wikimedia's API rate-limit policy.
evidence: The first categorymembers request on Category:Animated_films returned files, with a continuation token.
Further requests returned HTTP 429 'You are making too many requests to the API' from this environment's shared IP, pointing to https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs/Rate_limits.
sources.technical: Video files (WebM/Ogg) are served directly from upload.wikimedia.org; licenses are available per file via extmetadata.
restrictions: Rate limits apply per IP/User-Agent; a descriptive User-Agent is required by Wikimedia policy.
sources.next_action: From a network that is not rate-limited, record fixtures, confirm that category membership plus per-file license filtering yields a useful catalog, then implement.

sources.name: Muse Indonesia (official YouTube channel)

sources.permission: In-extension playback is prohibited by the YouTube Terms of Service.
evidence: Channel page og:title 'Muse Indonesia', channel UCxxnxya_32jcKj4yN1_kD7A.

YouTube Terms: users may not 'access, reproduce, download, distribute ... any part of the Service or any Content except: (a) as expressly authorized by the Service; or (b) with prior written permission from YouTube', nor 'access the Service using any automated means (such as robots, botnets or scrapers)' except public search engines.
sources.technical: A catalog-only module (Data API key per user, open in YouTube) is possible but would not provide playback in the app.
sources.next_action: Recommend the official YouTube app; reconsider only if the app gains a supported 'open externally' flow for official players.

sources.name: AniList API
sources.content: Anime metadata (titles, synopses, genres, airing); no video
